query: INSERT INTO analytics_snapshot_identities(owner_id,scope,day,kind,identity) SELECT DISTINCT owner_id,scope,day,'user',consumer_id FROM analytics_snapshot_contributions WHERE owner_id=$1 AND day=ANY($2) AND consumer_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT owner_id,scope,day,'session',session_identity FROM analytics_snapshot_contributions WHERE owner_id=$1 AND day=ANY($2) AND session_identity IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
